Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Bleed Amplification

Blood (Unleashed) places a debuff on enemies she hits, making them take 5x more bleed damage. Her best pair is with Berserker (Rage) or other good bleed units.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

The only other bleed amp unit in game is Bloodcry (Bloodfallen).

Can be stopped at upgrade 7 so you can have max duration for only 30k and low spa.
